table.retrieve:
SELECT
	String =
	/* ManfCode */ ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(I.ManfCode, 5))),'') + '~' +
	/* Date */ ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), :ad_enddate, 103))),'') + '~' +
	/* DistID */ ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(:as_distcode + REPLICATE(' ', 10 - LEN(:as_distcode)))), '') + '~' +
	/* ICode */ ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(I.ICode, 10))), '') + '~' +
	/* IteMName */ ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(I.Name)), '') + '~' +
	/* Packing */ ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(I.PackingDesc, ''))), '') + '~' +
	/* BatchNo */ ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.Batch)), '') + '~' +
	/* Trader Price */ ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(STR(I.SalePrice, 10, 2), ''))), '') + '~' +
	/* Opening Qty */ ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SUM(CASE T.Type WHEN 'OP' THEN T.Qty + T.Bonus ELSE 0 END), 10))), '0') + '~' +
	/* Opening Value */ ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SUM(CASE T.Type WHEN 'OP' THEN (T.Qty + T.Bonus) * I.SalePrice ELSE 0 END), 12, 2))), '0') + '~' +
	/* Closing Qty */ ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SUM(CASE T.Type WHEN 'CL' THEN T.Qty + T.Bonus ELSE 0 END), 10))), '0') + '~' +
	/* Closing Value */ ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SUM(CASE T.Type WHEN 'CL' THEN (T.Qty + T.Bonus) * I.SalePrice ELSE 0 END), 12, 2))), '0')
FROM
	Item I
	LEFT OUTER JOIN
	(SELECT type='OP', icode, batch, qty = sum(qty), bonus = sum(bonus)
	FROM	 
		(select pd.icode, pd.batch, 
			qty = sum(isnull(
				case pl.purcatcode 
				when 1 THEN (pd.packqty * pd.packunits)
				when 2 THEN (pd.packqty * pd.packunits)
				else pd.looseqty end, 0)), 
			bonus = sum(isnull(
				case pl.purcatcode 
				when 1 THEN (pd.bonusqty * pd.packunits)
				when 2 THEN (pd.bonusqty * pd.packunits)
				else pd.bonusqty end, 0))
		FROM 
			purledger pl, 
			purdetail pd, 
			(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT WHERE IT.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)) i
		WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND 
			pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
			pl.date < :ad_startdate AND
			pd.icode=i.icode
		Group By pd.icode, pd.batch
		UNION ALL
		select	pd.icode, pd.batch,
			qty  = - sum(pd.looseqty),
			bonus = - sum(pd.bonusqty)
		FROM 
			prledger pl, 
			prdetail pd, 
			(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT WHERE IT.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)) i
		WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
			pl.date < :ad_startdate AND
			pd.icode=i.icode
		Group By pd.icode, pd.batch
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, sd.batch,
			qty  = -sum(sd.looseqty),
			bonus  = -sum(sd.bonusqty)
		FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd, 
			(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT WHERE IT.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)) i
		WHERE sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND
			sl.posted = 'Y' AND 
		  	sl.date < :ad_startdate AND sd.Due IS NULL AND
			sd.icode=i.icode 
		Group By sd.icode, sd.batch
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, sd.batch,
			qty  = sum(sd.looseqty),
			bonus = sum(sd.bonusqty)
		FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd, 
			(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT WHERE IT.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)) i
		WHERE 
			sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
			sl.posted = 'Y' AND 
		   	sl.date < :ad_startdate AND
			sd.icode=i.icode
		Group By sd.icode, sd.batch
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, sd.batch, qty  = -sum(sd.qty), bonus = 0
		FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd, 
			(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT WHERE IT.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)) i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
			sl.date < :ad_startdate AND
			sd.icode=i.icode 
		Group By sd.icode, sd.batch
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, sd.batch, qty  = sum(sd.qty), bonus=0
		FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd, 
			(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT WHERE IT.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)) i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
			sl.date < :ad_startdate AND sd.icode=i.icode
		Group By sd.icode, sd.batch
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, sd.batch, qty = sum(sd.looseqty), bonus=0
		FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd, 
			(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT WHERE IT.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)) i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
		      sl.date < :ad_startdate AND sd.icode=i.icode 
		Group By sd.icode, sd.batch
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, sd.batch, qty = -sum(sd.looseqty), bonus=0
		FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd, 
			(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT WHERE IT.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)) i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
			sl.date < :ad_startdate AND sd.icode=i.icode
		Group By sd.icode, sd.batch
		UNION ALL
		select	d.icode, d.batch, qty = -sum(d.duesatisfyqty), bonus=0
		FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d, 
			(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT WHERE IT.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)) i
		WHERE h.duesatisfycode=d.duesatisfycode AND
			h.duesatisfydate < :ad_startdate AND
			d.icode=i.icode 
		Group By d.icode, d.batch) A
	GROUP BY icode, batch
	UNION ALL
	SELECT type='CL', icode, batch, qty = sum(qty), bonus = sum(bonus)
	FROM	
		(select pd.icode, pd.batch, 
			qty = sum(isnull(
				case pl.purcatcode 
				when 1 THEN (pd.packqty * pd.packunits)
				when 2 THEN (pd.packqty * pd.packunits)
				else pd.looseqty end, 0)), 
			bonus = sum(isnull(
				case pl.purcatcode 
				when 1 THEN (pd.bonusqty * pd.packunits)
				when 2 THEN (pd.bonusqty * pd.packunits)
				else pd.bonusqty end, 0))
		FROM 
			purledger pl, 
			purdetail pd, 
			(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT WHERE IT.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)) i
		WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND 
			pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
			pl.date <= :ad_enddate AND
			pd.icode=i.icode
		Group By pd.icode, pd.batch
		UNION ALL
		select	pd.icode, pd.batch,
			qty  = - sum(pd.looseqty),
			bonus = - sum(pd.bonusqty)
		FROM 
			prledger pl, 
			prdetail pd, 
			(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT WHERE IT.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)) i
		WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
			pl.date <= :ad_enddate AND
			pd.icode=i.icode
		Group By pd.icode, pd.batch
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, sd.batch,
			qty  = -sum(sd.looseqty),
			bonus  = -sum(sd.bonusqty)
		FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd, 
			(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT WHERE IT.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)) i
		WHERE sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND
			sl.posted = 'Y' AND 
		  	sl.date <= :ad_enddate AND sd.Due IS NULL AND
			sd.icode=i.icode 
		Group By sd.icode, sd.batch
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, sd.batch,
			qty  = sum(sd.looseqty),
			bonus = sum(sd.bonusqty)
		FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd, 
			(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT WHERE IT.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)) i
		WHERE 
			sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
			sl.posted = 'Y' AND 
		   	sl.date <= :ad_enddate AND
			sd.icode=i.icode
		Group By sd.icode, sd.batch
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, sd.batch, qty  = -sum(sd.qty), bonus = 0
		FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd, 
			(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT WHERE IT.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)) i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
			sl.date <= :ad_enddate AND
			sd.icode=i.icode 
		Group By sd.icode, sd.batch
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, sd.batch, qty  = sum(sd.qty), bonus=0
		FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd, 
			(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT WHERE IT.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)) i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
			sl.date <= :ad_enddate AND sd.icode=i.icode
		Group By sd.icode, sd.batch
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, sd.batch, qty = sum(sd.looseqty), bonus=0
		FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd, 
			(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT WHERE IT.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)) i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
		      sl.date <= :ad_enddate AND sd.icode=i.icode 
		Group By sd.icode, sd.batch
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, sd.batch, qty = -sum(sd.looseqty), bonus=0
		FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd, 
			(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT WHERE IT.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)) i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
			sl.date <= :ad_enddate AND sd.icode=i.icode
		Group By sd.icode, sd.batch
		UNION ALL
		select	d.icode, d.batch, qty = -sum(d.duesatisfyqty), bonus=0
		FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d, 
			(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT WHERE IT.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)) i
		WHERE h.duesatisfycode=d.duesatisfycode AND
			h.duesatisfydate <= :ad_enddate AND
			d.icode=i.icode 
		Group By d.icode, d.batch) A
	GROUP BY icode, batch) T ON (I.ICode = T.ICode)
WHERE
	I.ManfCode = :ai_manfcode
GROUP BY
	I.ManfCode, 
	I.ICode, 
	I.Name,
	I.PackingDesc, 
	T.Batch,
	I.SalePrice
